mentions.name: Opslane
mentions.description: Open-source agent that combines error tracking with session recording to identify and investigate user-facing issues. It reduces false positives by ranking issues based on how many users are affected, learns about the product by reading its code and watching session recordings, and reviews recordings for rage clicks, dead clicks, and abandoned forms to catch issues that don't throw exceptions.
mentions.problem: Traditional error trackers have two failure modes: false positives, where thousands of errors are shown with no way to tell their impact on users, and false negatives, where user-facing issues that don't throw exceptions go unnoticed.
mentions.audience: Engineering teams monitoring user-facing issues in their software products.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on Opslane, an open-source agent that identifies user-facing issues and investigates them.
mentions.author: aray07
